findings.message: Stream 1 is coded as PCM (format tag 0x0001), which has no parser here; its media objects are not analyzed.
2 payloads belong to stream 0, which no Stream Properties Object describes; readers ignore them (section 8.2.7).
The packet at 0x246 states more padding than the packet holds after its header.
The packet at 0x346 states that it holds no payloads (section 5.2.3.3).
2 packets, the first at 0x346, states a padding length that differs from the padding its layout leaves (section 8.2.15).
The packet at 0x446 holds a payload whose replicated data is 2 to 7 bytes, too few for the media object's size and time (section 5.2.3.1).
2 packets, the first at 0x546, holds a payload for stream 0, which is not a stream.
The packet at 0x646 states a packet length that differs from the packet size in the File Properties Object (section 8.2.13).
The packet at 0x746 has a stream number length type other than 1; the specification fixes it to a byte (section 5.2.2), and readers read a byte.
The packet at 0x746 has an error correction length type other than 0, which the specification reserves (section 5.2.1).
